titre: Report day on the space ship
story_context: Capitaine Karniella, c'est le jour des bulletins sur le vaisseau ! Le robot professeur distribue les school reports, mais il ne sait pas dire ce que les élèves sont en train de faire. Apprends-lui le vocabulaire du collège et le présent continu.

micro_learning_blocks.contenu: To line up = to queue up. To be late ≠ to be on time. To receive a report = to receive a school report. To work hard = to work a lot.
To be top of = to be the best of ; to be bottom of = to be the worst of. Well done = nice job, very good. To go up = passer en classe supérieure ; to stay down = redoubler.
Le présent continu dit ce qu'on fait en ce moment : sujet + am / is / are + verbe-ing. I am writing on the board. You are speaking English. N'oublie ni BE, ni -ING !

micro_learning_blocks.titre: ❓ Poser la question, demander la permission
micro_learning_blocks.contenu: Question : Are you learning English now? — Yes, we are. / No, we aren't. What are you doing now? — We are learning English. Permission : Can I read the text, sir? May I go out, sir? — Yes, you may. / No, you may not.

quiz.question: To stay down means…
options: To go to the next class
quiz.explanation: To stay down = to repeat the class.

quiz.question: The opposite of « to be top of » is…
Pour demander poliment la permission de sortir :
quiz.explanation: May + I + verbe à la base. May est le plus poli.
